permit: For work visible from a public street or alley within York’s local HARB district, contact the city about historic review before changing the exterior. The city also says a building permit is required when replacement exceeds 25% of any one roof surface.
weather: NOAA reported fallen trees and wires in York after thunderstorm winds estimated near 60 mph on July 15, 2024. Check for branch impact and loose roof edges from the ground.

permit: Hanover’s residential building permit form covers structural changes and additions. Describe any decking or framing changes when asking which paperwork applies.
weather: NOAA recorded 1.75-inch hail on the south side of Hanover and in Parkville in September 2024. Ask for a ground-level look at vulnerable metal and an inspection of the affected roof slopes.

permit: Red Lion directs applicants to submit building permits through its borough office. Its permit summary lists structural changes to a dwelling among work that requires a permit.
Springettsbury’s Community Development Department handles building permits. Describe the existing roof and any new framing separately when you check your proposed scope.
weather: NOAA logged a July 16, 2024 thunderstorm that downed dozens of trees in Springettsbury Township, including one that fell on a home.

permit: York Township’s Building and Zoning Department asks property owners to contact the township about permit requirements for the proposed work. Confirm the parcel before using the township instructions.
Spring Garden’s permit page lists replacement of shingles or a rubber roof as permit-exempt. It lists roof framing replacement and a new roof over a porch or patio as building permit work.

West Manchester Township lists asphalt-shingle replacement, house siding, and same-size window replacement among projects that need no permit. Confirm the scope with Zoning and Codes if work extends beyond those listed items.
Wrightsville publishes building permit instructions on its Permits and Ordinances page. Ask the borough to review the actual scope when work changes an exterior assembly.

weather: NOAA recorded a June 29, 2024 thunderstorm that brought down multiple trees near Dover, with wind estimated at 60 mph.
permit: Dover Borough publishes its own building and zoning permit form. Use the borough form for a borough parcel and describe the roof work in the application.

weather: NOAA reports quarter-sized hail in Glen Rock on April 15, 2024. Compare sheltered and exposed roof features when documenting evidence of impact.
permit: Glen Rock maintains separate residential building and zoning applications and directs residents to its borough office for scope-specific questions.

weather: NOAA recorded 1.5-inch hail northeast of New Freedom on April 15, 2024. A roof inspection can check the most exposed slopes and metal details.
NOAA recorded downed trees and a fence southeast of Stewartstown in a June 5, 2024 thunderstorm. The reported wind was estimated near 60 mph.
permit: Stewartstown publishes residential building and zoning applications for borough properties and directs homeowners to contact the borough office before applying.

weather: NOAA’s September 21, 2024 storm narrative reports 1.5-inch hail in Manchester. The event record uses Mount Wolf as its location label.
NOAA reports downed trees and power lines in Mount Wolf during a September 21, 2024 thunderstorm with winds estimated near 60 mph.

permit: Dallastown’s building permit guidelines list roofing and changing the dimensions of a window opening. The borough asks applicants to submit drawings with the application.
Dillsburg’s ordinances page says a building permit is needed before new construction. For repairs to the existing roof, ask the borough how it classifies the planned work.
